Required adaptation: Host inside Android WebView with responsive viewport meta and CSS height adjustments

Purpose: Window management, deep linking, native dialogs, shell execution, contextBridge
Dependencies: Electron C++ bindings, Node.js stdlib, Chromium IPC
Required adaptation: Implement Android @JavascriptInterface (e.g. AntigravityHostBridge) or inject window.* shims via WebView evaluateJavascript

Purpose: Agent loop orchestration, RPC handler, SQLite persistence, tool execution, safety checks
Dependencies: Windows Win32 APIs, x86_64 CPU instructions, CGO SQLite
Android compatibility classification: D - Not currently feasible (on-device binary execution); C - Requires alternative integration (remote host pairing)
Required adaptation: Cannot run x86_64 PE on Android ARM64; must either connect to desktop host via Hub discovery or re-implement active RPCs in native Kotlin
Known blockers: Architecture mismatch (x86_64 vs ARM64), OS binary format (PE vs ELF), proprietary google3 source code

Purpose: Encodes browser session recordings and screen captures to WebM for agent inspection
Dependencies: Windows PE, x86_64, multimedia codecs
Required adaptation: Use Android MediaCodec / MediaRecorder APIs for on-device encoding or delegate to host
Known blockers: Cannot execute x86_64 binary; screen capture requires Android MediaProjection permissions

Purpose: Serves 364 RPC endpoints over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with Connect protocol and gRPC-Web framing
Dependencies: Go net/http, crypto/tls, Connect-RPC Go runtime
Required adaptation: Native Android NanoHTTPD / Ktor embedded server or WebViewClient.shouldInterceptRequest handler implementing gRPC-Web binary framing
Known blockers: gRPC-Web framing bytes (0x00 data frame, 0x80 trailer frame) and trailer headers must be precisely maintained

Purpose: Accepts self-signed TLS certificates on 127.0.0.1 for secure loopback RPC
Dependencies: Chromium NetworkService certificate verification hook
Required adaptation: Override WebViewClient.onReceivedSslError for localhost/127.0.0.1 or use plaintext HTTP with cleartextTrafficPermitted on loopback
Known blockers: Android WebView enforces strict SSL validation by default and rejects untrusted certs

Purpose: Stores trajectory metadata, individual steps, metadata blobs, and battle mode info per conversation
Dependencies: SQLite3 C library, filesystem directory ~/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/
Required adaptation: Use Android SQLiteOpenHelper or Room database with identical schema (steps, trajectory_meta, gen_metadata)
Known blockers: Schema compatibility must be 100% exact to allow importing existing desktop conversations
